description: PR salvage, conflict resolution, and stale review cases for automated queue triage

cases.scenario: Branch carries changes already partially or wholly squashed into main
cases.historicalContext: PR #45 carried release-workflow git-path resolution and trap fixes already landed via PR #44 squash
cases.action: Inspect commit diff vs merge-base. If tree-identical or redundant, close with clear attribution to earlier landing.
cases.safetyGate: Verify no unique behavioral fixes or unlanded regression tests are lost before closing.

cases.scenario: Merged PR left uncommitted documentation or changelog entries behind
cases.historicalContext: PR #57 merged without CHANGELOG.md unreleased entries. Salvaged via docs follow-up PR #59 with paired records.
cases.action: Extract unreleased changelog notes, create docs-only branch, pair with feature_list.json and claude-progress.md, and open clean PR.
cases.safetyGate: Check diff gate paths to ensure no compiled code is modified in docs-only branch.

cases.scenario: Merge conflict in feature_list.json or claude-progress.md across long-running branch
cases.historicalContext: Automated merge drivers (merge-records-json.sh and merge-records-md.sh) resolve additions by ID and heading block.
cases.action: Use local merge drivers or union feature array by feature ID and timestamp. Validate with bash scripts/test-records-merge.sh.
cases.safetyGate: Ensure JSON remains strictly valid and no existing feature IDs or evidences are dropped.
